scope: Two unknowns: valid prehistory peak and cohesive fracture energy. Deliberately matched small-probe response pairs test identifiability and new-impact divergence; not a general material benchmark.
protocol: Known-model input must omit fracture_energy. Every candidate explicitly supplies its own energy and fully replays its own prehistory.
Construct paired histories with equal unloading tangent stiffness using the existing cohesive law; verify that the observed probe does not increase their damage history.
Same noise realization within each pair. Never replace one member's rendered observations with the other's to manufacture equality.
A preset stronger observed probe is included as an information control; it may add damage and is not a learned or guaranteed-safe probing policy.
Optimizer input has no pair identities, true parameter values or future plans. Freeze parameter/state candidate packets before future prediction and private-label evaluation.
2D multiregion starts with a 3x3 grid, refines low-score cells twice and the widest cell once, and stops at 49 distinct evaluations. Partial last subdivision is retained honestly.
Retain all observation-matched physical hypotheses. A lowest-loss representative is not a uniquely identified material state. Finite candidate envelopes have no coverage guarantee.
No neural model training, no test-based tuning, no novelty or general 3D-fracture claim.
